We stand in solidarity with all those here in Canada and around the world who are fighting against anti-black racism, injustice & hate. 

Check out @BLAC_Ontario @fbcfcn & @BlackHealthCAN to support this work. 

#BlacklivesMatter #JusticeForGeorgeFloyd #JusticeForRegis

The human rights of everyone, everywhere are at the heart of our work. But we recognize that to dismantle oppressive systems we must do more than we ever have before. 

Read our full solidarity statement below. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/vZI3HWRCLf

#BlackLivesMatter: We recognize that our solidarity is not enough, we must take tangible actions. This work is not easy, but we are committed to doing it because we recognize the role we play in making our world a better, safer, and more equitable place. https://t.co/vZI3HWRCLf https://t.co/hRVZQ51n6O
